title: Credential Symphony: compact credential orchestration and ergonomic stream adapters
author: Hannah Li
release_notes: Introduce a compact credential orchestration layer (Credential Composer) and lightweight ergonomic stream adapters across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Adds prefetch hints, idempotent retry shim, and minimal API polish. Backwards-compatible; bumps minor versions for each SDK. Fixes cross-lang parity gaps in streaming handshake and improves failure telemetry.
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs evolved different credential flows and stream ergonomics which led to small interoperability gaps and duplicated retry logic. This PR introduces a compact credential orchestration abstraction (Credential Composer) plus thin, idiomatic stream adapter layers in Python/TypeScript/Go to unify behavior while keeping each SDK idiomatic. Key goals: 1) unify prefetch/hint signals so servers can warm tokens without changing caller code; 2) centralize a small set of idempotent retry presets to reduce ad-hoc backoff differences; 3) provide ergonomic async iter/stream helpers that surface retry and cancel semantics consistently across languages; 4) keep surface changes minimal to avoid client churn. What changed: implemented Credential Composer (fallback chain + prefetch hints + metrics hooks); added typed StreamAdapter in TS, StreamHandle helpers in Python, and cred-fanout/adapter in Go; introduced an idempotent retry shim and a small compatibility layer to map legacy token callbacks to the composer; updated examples and integration tests; bumped SDK minor versions (py 2.6.0, ts 1.28.0, go 1.8.0). Checklist: [x] design doc posted in ENG-2743, [x] unit tests added, [x] e2e integration tests for streaming, [x] docs updated in SDK examples, [x] release notes drafted. Compatibility notes: default behavior preserves existing token callback semantics; opt-in composer via new ClientOptions. Rollout: feature flagged for gradual enablement, can be disabled per-client. Related: ENG-2743 (design), ENG-2790 (parity tests).
